title: Occlusal changes after mandibular advancement device therapy with and without a morning occlusal guide
summary: This clinical study aims to evaluate the efficacy of a morning occlusal guide in patients undergoing treatment with a mandibular advancement device. The study investigates whether the use of a morning occlusal guide as part of mandibular advancement therapy can reduce changes of tooth movements and tooth contacts compared to patients without a morning occlusal guide and whether the occurrence of side effects is independent of the extent of breathing-related sleep values and the extent of mandibular advancement and is rather due to the stability of tooth-related characteristics.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Indication for treatment with mandibular advancement device (primary ronchopathy or AHI ≥ 5) 
- At least 8 teeth per jaw (including the anterior teeth in the upper and lower jaw)
Exclusion criteria:
- No consent to participate
- Combination therapy (CPAP or hypoglossal nerve stimulation)
- Removable dentures
